name: Shine Sweep
description: A brushed-metal title rises through a mask and a bright highlight band glides across the letters.
move: A brushed-metal title rises through a mask and a bright highlight band glides across the letters.
how: Two background layers clipped to text: a 250%-wide white band over a vertical metal gradient. Animating background-position of the band from 110% to -10% over 1.5s (power2.inOut) is the sweep. The title rises yPercent 105→0 with blur clearing.
adapt: Change the gradient stops for a coloured metal; sweep angle is the 105deg in the band gradient. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "CC Light Sweep" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
